features: Immersive JBL 9-Speaker System Tuned by Dolby Atmos – Experience truly cinematic sound with a premium JBL 9-unit speaker setup featuring 4 tweeters, 3 woofers, and 2 passive radiators. Enhanced with Dolby Atmos, Hi-Res Audio, and Wireless Hi-Res Audio support, every movie, game, and playlist delivers rich, room-filling sound with deep bass and crystal-clear detail. Includes an 8MP front camera and a 13MP rear camera for sharp video calls and everyday photography.

Immersive 12.1-Inch 2.5K Display for Cinematic Entertainment – Experience stunning visuals on a vibrant 12.1-inch 2.5K display with a sharp 2560 × 1600 resolution, ultra-smooth 120Hz refresh rate, and up to 800 nits of brightness. With 98% DCI-P3 cinema-grade colour coverage and TÜV Low Blue Light certification, every movie, game, and show comes to life with exceptional clarity, rich colours, and comfortable viewing.

High-Speed 8GB Memory with Expansive 256GB Storage – Featuring 8GB LPDDR4x RAM for seamless multitasking and 256GB UFS 2.2 storage for faster app launches and quick file access, this tablet delivers a smooth and responsive user experience. With support for microSD expansion up to 2TB, you'll have plenty of space for games, downloads, movies, photos, and all your favourite entertainment.

Powerful MediaTek Dimensity 7400 with Advanced Graphics Performance – Featuring the latest MediaTek Dimensity 7400 octa-core processor with four high-performance Cortex-A78 cores clocked at up to 2.6GHz, four power-efficient Cortex-A55 cores, and the Arm Mali-G615 MC2 GPU, this platform delivers fast processing, smooth graphics, and responsive multitasking — making it ideal for gaming, streaming, content creation, and everyday productivity.

Powerful 10200mAh Battery Built for Extended Entertainment – Featuring a high-capacity 10200mAh integrated battery, this device delivers up to 15 hours of YouTube streaming and up to 15.5 hours of Chrome browsing on a single charge. Designed for long-lasting entertainment, it ensures you can enjoy movies, games, and browsing throughout the day. With the in-box 45W charging adapter, you get fast and convenient recharging whenever needed.
